review_kind: Codex (OpenAI) AI translation and review on 2026-11-19 of Qt error-message batch 6 mask loading, puncta inputs and volume editing. No human or native-speaker signoff.

records.key:
Puncta detection requires a 2-D image and matching parent mask.

Load a two-dimensional image and a parent mask with the same height and width.
records.source:
Puncta detection requires a 2-D image and matching parent mask.

Load a two-dimensional image and a parent mask with the same height and width.
records.translation:
Punktagreining krefst 2-D myndar og samsvarandi foreldramaska.

Hladdu inn tvívíðri mynd og foreldramaska með sömu hæð og breidd.

records.key:
Image and parent mask must contain finite values.

Load an image and parent mask without NaN or infinite values.
records.source:
Image and parent mask must contain finite values.

Load an image and parent mask without NaN or infinite values.
records.translation:
Mynd og foreldramaski verða að innihalda endanleg tölugildi.

Hladdu inn mynd og foreldramaska án NaN eða óendanlegra gilda.

records.key:
Parent masks must contain nonnegative integer labels.

Load a labelled mask with zero for background and positive whole numbers for objects.
records.source:
Parent masks must contain nonnegative integer labels.

Load a labelled mask with zero for background and positive whole numbers for objects.
records.translation:
Foreldramaskar verða að innihalda óneikvæð heiltölumerki.

Hladdu inn merktum maska með núlli fyrir bakgrunn og jákvæðum heiltölum fyrir hluti.

records.key:
Invalid puncta scale, threshold, centre-pixel or spacing settings.

Enter finite values: positive scales and k, a nonnegative edge margin, 1 to 81 centre pixels, and integer spacing of at least 1 pixel.
records.source:
Invalid puncta scale, threshold, centre-pixel or spacing settings.

Enter finite values: positive scales and k, a nonnegative edge margin, 1 to 81 centre pixels, and integer spacing of at least 1 pixel.
records.translation:
Ógildar stillingar fyrir punktakvarða, þröskuld, miðjupixla eða bil.

Sláðu inn endanleg gildi: jákvæða kvarða og k, óneikvætt jaðarbil, 1 til 81 miðjupixla og heiltölubil sem er að minnsta kosti 1 pixill.

records.key:
The selected image plane exceeds the 256 MiB editor limit.

Use Import to prepare a smaller image before opening it in the editor.
records.source:
The selected image plane exceeds the 256 MiB editor limit.

Use Import to prepare a smaller image before opening it in the editor.
records.translation:
Valda myndplanið fer yfir 256 MiB hámark ritilsins.

Notaðu innflutning til að útbúa minni mynd áður en þú opnar hana í ritlinum.

records.key:
The reader returned an invalid or changed image plane.

Reopen the source and select a valid image plane.
records.source:
The reader returned an invalid or changed image plane.

Reopen the source and select a valid image plane.
records.translation:
Lesarinn skilaði ógildu eða breyttu myndplani.

Opnaðu upprunann aftur og veldu gilt myndplan.

records.key:
The image source is not a regular file.

Select an existing image file instead of a folder or device.
records.source:
The image source is not a regular file.

Select an existing image file instead of a folder or device.
records.translation:
Uppspretta myndarinnar er ekki venjuleg skrá.

Veldu fyrirliggjandi myndskrá í stað möppu eða tækis.

records.key:
3D masks require a finite numeric spatial TIFF within the volume memory budget.

Open a finite numeric 3D volume with at most 16,777,216 voxels and 256 MiB of decoded data.
records.source:
3D masks require a finite numeric spatial TIFF within the volume memory budget.

Open a finite numeric 3D volume with at most 16,777,216 voxels and 256 MiB of decoded data.
records.translation:
3D-grímur krefjast endanlegrar, tölulegrar, rúmlægrar TIFF-skrár innan minnismarka rúmmálsins.

Opnaðu tölulegt 3D-rúmmál með endanlegum gildum, að hámarki 16,777,216 voxlum og 256 MiB af afkóðuðum gögnum.

records.key:
Voxel spacing must contain three positive finite distances.

Enter one positive spacing value for each spatial axis, in the stored axis order.
records.source:
Voxel spacing must contain three positive finite distances.

Enter one positive spacing value for each spatial axis, in the stored axis order.
records.translation:
Voxlabil verður að innihalda þrjár jákvæðar endanlegar fjarlægðir.

Sláðu inn eitt jákvætt bil fyrir hvern rúmás, í geymdri röð ásanna.

records.key:
The physical image bounds must be finite.

Check the image dimensions and voxel spacing, then reopen the volume with valid physical dimensions.
records.source:
The physical image bounds must be finite.

Check the image dimensions and voxel spacing, then reopen the volume with valid physical dimensions.
records.translation:
Efnisleg mörk myndarinnar verða að vera endanleg.

Athugaðu stærð myndarinnar og voxlabilið og opnaðu síðan rúmmálið aftur með gildum efnislegum stærðum.

records.key:
The volume mask must contain matching nonnegative integer object labels up to 65535.

Load a mask with the same shape as the volume and integer labels from 0 to 65535.
records.source:
The volume mask must contain matching nonnegative integer object labels up to 65535.

Load a mask with the same shape as the volume and integer labels from 0 to 65535.
records.translation:
Rúmmálsgríman verður að innihalda samsvarandi óneikvæð heiltöluhlutamerki upp að 65535.

Hladdu inn grímu með sömu lögun og rúmmálið og heiltölumerkjum frá 0 til 65535.

records.key:
The section index lies outside the volume.

Select a section within the displayed range for the chosen axis.
records.source:
The section index lies outside the volume.

Select a section within the displayed range for the chosen axis.
records.translation:
Sneiðarvísirinn er utan rúmmálsins.

Veldu sneið innan sýnda bilsins fyrir valinn ás.

records.key:
The drawn section does not match the volume section.

Redraw the section on the current volume plane with matching dimensions.
records.source:
The drawn section does not match the volume section.

Redraw the section on the current volume plane with matching dimensions.
records.translation:
Teiknaða sneiðin passar ekki við sneið rúmmálsins.

Teiknaðu sneiðina aftur á núverandi plan rúmmálsins með samsvarandi stærð.

records.key:
The detected labels do not match the volume.

Run detection again on the current volume and use labels with the same dimensions.
records.source:
The detected labels do not match the volume.

Run detection again on the current volume and use labels with the same dimensions.
records.translation:
Greindu merkin passa ekki við rúmmálið.

Keyrðu greiningu aftur á núverandi rúmmáli og notaðu merki með sömu stærð.

records.key:
The edited volume overlaps another object; no labels were changed.

Move or resize the edited boundary so it does not overlap another object, then apply it again.
records.source:
The edited volume overlaps another object; no labels were changed.

Move or resize the edited boundary so it does not overlap another object, then apply it again.
records.translation:
Breytta rúmmálið skarast við annan hlut; engum merkjum var breytt.

Færðu breyttu mörkin eða breyttu stærð þeirra þannig að þau skarist ekki við annan hlut og beittu þeim síðan aftur.

records.key:
This edit exceeds the volume undo memory budget; no labels were changed.

Apply the change in smaller steps or work on a smaller volume.
records.source:
This edit exceeds the volume undo memory budget; no labels were changed.

Apply the change in smaller steps or work on a smaller volume.
records.translation:
Þessi breyting fer yfir minnismörk afturköllunar í rúmmálinu; engum merkjum var breytt.

Beittu breytingunni í smærri skrefum eða vinndu með minna rúmmál.

records.key:
The source volume changed while opening it.

Wait until the source file is stable, then reopen the volume.
records.source:
The source volume changed while opening it.

Wait until the source file is stable, then reopen the volume.
records.translation:
Upprunarúmmálið breyttist á meðan það var opnað.

Bíddu þar til upprunaskráin hættir að breytast og opnaðu síðan rúmmálið aftur.

records.key:
The source volume changed; no mask was saved.

Reload the current source volume before editing and saving its mask.
records.source:
The source volume changed; no mask was saved.

Reload the current source volume before editing and saving its mask.
records.translation:
Upprunarúmmálið breyttist; engin gríma var vistuð.

Hladdu núverandi upprunarúmmáli aftur inn áður en þú breytir grímunni og vistar hana.

records.key:
The mask output must not overwrite the source volume.

Choose a different output file for the mask.
records.source:
The mask output must not overwrite the source volume.

Choose a different output file for the mask.
records.translation:
Grímuúttakið má ekki skrifa yfir upprunarúmmálið.

Veldu aðra úttaksskrá fyrir grímuna.

records.key:
This volume is already being saved.

Wait for the current save to finish before saving again.
records.source:
This volume is already being saved.

Wait for the current save to finish before saving again.
records.translation:
Verið er að vista þetta rúmmál nú þegar.

Bíddu þar til yfirstandandi vistun lýkur áður en þú vistar aftur.

records.key:
The saved volume changed outside this session; no mask was overwritten.

Reopen the latest saved volume before making further edits.
records.source:
The saved volume changed outside this session; no mask was overwritten.

Reopen the latest saved volume before making further edits.
records.translation:
Vistaða rúmmálinu var breytt utan þessarar lotu; engin gríma var yfirskrifuð.

Opnaðu nýjustu vistuðu útgáfu rúmmálsins aftur áður en þú gerir frekari breytingar.

records.key:
The volume files changed during saving; no output was replaced.

Stop other writes to these files, reopen the current volume, and save again.
records.source:
The volume files changed during saving; no output was replaced.

Stop other writes to these files, reopen the current volume, and save again.
records.translation:
Rúmmálsskrárnar breyttust við vistun; engu úttaki var skipt út.

Stöðvaðu aðrar skrifaðgerðir í þessar skrár, opnaðu núverandi rúmmál aftur og vistaðu á ný.

records.key:
The saved volume geometry does not match these source and mask pixels.

Open the matching source, mask and geometry sidecar from the same saved volume.
records.source:
The saved volume geometry does not match these source and mask pixels.

Open the matching source, mask and geometry sidecar from the same saved volume.
records.translation:
Vistuð rúmfræði rúmmálsins passar ekki við þessa uppruna- og grímudíla.

Opnaðu samsvarandi uppruna, grímu og rúmfræðihliðarskrá úr sama vistaða rúmmáli.

records.key:
The saved volume anchor controls are invalid.

Open a saved volume with valid anchor controls, or restore a matching backup.
records.source:
The saved volume anchor controls are invalid.

Open a saved volume with valid anchor controls, or restore a matching backup.
records.translation:
Vistaðar akkerisstillingar rúmmálsins eru ógildar.

Opnaðu vistað rúmmál með gildum akkerisstillingum eða endurheimtu samsvarandi öryggisafrit.

records.key:
The saved mask axes do not match the spatial source.

Choose the mask saved for this volume with the same spatial axis order.
records.source:
The saved mask axes do not match the spatial source.

Choose the mask saved for this volume with the same spatial axis order.
records.translation:
Ásar vistuðu grímunnar passa ekki við rúmlæga upprunann.

Veldu grímuna sem var vistuð fyrir þetta rúmmál með sömu röð rúmása.
